picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission aims to link the agency's supercomputers, scientific datasets, and experimental facilities into a unified AI-for-discovery infrastructure — a national-scale bet on AI-accelerated science with the resources to back it up.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: CERN and Mistral's deal to train a foundation model on billions of simulated particle collisions marks one of the most concrete pairings yet of frontier AI labs with fundamental physics research.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced, 14-plus-university compute consortium signals a coordinated regional push to build shared AI infrastructure outside the usual handful of elite research hubs.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: Rico Sennrich's ACL Test of Time Award recognizes subword tokenization (BPE) as the quiet technical foundation underpinning nearly every modern large language model — a reminder that today's AI boom rests on a decade-old breakthrough.
picks.title: A Smart Computer

picks.editorial_note: A $28.6 million federal award to study protein misfolding in neurodegenerative disease, with machine learning central to the approach, is a substantial bet on AI's role in tackling a major unmet medical need.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: AURORA's robot-controlled, AI-enhanced cloud laboratory for discovering quantum materials represents exactly the kind of autonomous-science infrastructure that could meaningfully speed up materials discovery.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2 million Army Research Office award to study light propagation through complex environments pairs serious defense funding with AI-driven optical sensing and imaging research.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's work on detecting internal warning signs of unsafe LLM behavior, prompted by a real 2026 testing incident, speaks directly to the AI safety and governance questions now shaping policy debates.
picks.title: Can We Detect Harmful AI Before It’s Too Late? Researchers Search for Warning Signs

picks.editorial_note: A $2.2 million Google.org grant to build an AI-driven atlas of chemotherapy resistance mechanisms is a concrete example of philanthropic AI-for-science funding aimed squarely at cancer treatment outcomes.
picks.title: AI for science: Google.org funding to support ANU-led chemotherapy resistance cancer research

picks.editorial_note: ASU's campus-wide AI supercomputing platform, backed by an Intel donation, is a notable move to democratize access to advanced compute for all students and researchers rather than a select few labs.
picks.title: ASU provides access to AI-supercomputing for all
